description: What the router's firewall does with new connections from one zone to another, or to the router itself: rules in order, then a default.

default.description: What happens to a connection no rule matches; `reject` answers with an administratively prohibited error.

rules.description: Rules in order: the first that matches a connection decides.

action.description: What happens to a connection the rule matches; `reject` answers with an administratively prohibited error.

destination.description: Destination address ranges, or one `set:<name>` for the ranges of an AddressSet; empty matches every destination.

destinationPorts.description: Destination ports, each a port or a range `<first>-<last>`, with the protocol `tcp`, `udp` or `sctp`; empty matches every port.

family.description: Address family the rule matches; null matches each family its protocol and addresses leave.

icmpTypes.description: ICMP or ICMPv6 types, with the protocol `icmp` or `icmpv6`; empty matches every type. `packet-too-big` is ICMPv6's.

log.description: Whether the kernel logs each packet the rule matches, prefixed with the policy's name and the rule's number.

protocol.description: Protocol the rule matches; null matches every protocol. `icmp` is IPv4's and `icmpv6` IPv6's.

source.description: Source address ranges, or one `set:<name>` for the ranges of an AddressSet; empty matches every source. In each family the rule matches the ranges of that family.

sourcePorts.description: Source ports, each a port or a range `<first>-<last>`, with the protocol `tcp`, `udp` or `sctp`; empty matches every port.

to.description: FirewallZone the connections go to, or `local` for connections to the router itself.
